as_told.title: Puharich meditates in the King's Chamber

plain: Tape recordings exist of the researcher Andrija Puharich meditating inside the King's Chamber, the main room deep inside the Great Pyramid, according to two researchers on the show. The researcher Greg Malatzi tells Michels, 'We have tape recordings of him meditating in the King's Chamber.' A second researcher in the same episode, who is not named, says the same and dates the recordings to 1976, prompting a surprised 'What?' from Michels. Both speak as people who have the tapes or have studied them, not as people who were there. The episode is about Puharich, who by their account tried to contact an alien council, so the tapes matter to them as a record of him taking that work into the pyramid itself.
